name: Sage Intacct
description: Sage Intacct is cloud financial management software for growing and midsize organizations, with core accounting, multi-entity consolidation, reporting, budgeting, purchasing, cash management, revenue management, projects, and extensible business workflows.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact Sage Intacct company or intentionally selected entity with a customer-owned REST application and dedicated least-privilege Web Services user. Relay exchanges the encrypted client credentials and exact username for a short-lived bearer token on Railway, pins Sage's production API origin and reporting-period object, exposes only first-response listing capped at twenty-five and one exact opaque-key read, and excludes people, accounts, balances, budgets, transactions, reports, arbitrary APIs, XML Web Services, pagination, and writes.

credentialRequirements.label: Sage Intacct REST client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the client ID for the customer-owned production REST application authorized in the target company.

credentialRequirements.label: Sage Intacct REST client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Store the matching client secret only through Relay's encrypted credential boundary.

credentialRequirements.label: Dedicated Sage Intacct Web Services username
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the exact API-only username bound to the authorized client application and target company; include an entity suffix only for an intentional entity binding.

capabilities.label: Read reporting periods
capabilities.description: List bounded reporting-period summaries or inspect one exact period without accounts, balances, budgets, transactions, reports, people, or relationships.

approvalRequired.label: List reporting periods
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five bounded reporting-period summaries from Sage Intacct's first collection response.

approvalRequired.label: Read reporting period
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact bounded reporting-period summary by opaque provider key.

blocked.label: Change Sage Intacct data
blocked.description: Creating, updating, deleting, posting, approving, closing, reopening, importing, or otherwise changing Sage Intacct records is outside V1.

blocked.label: Read private business data
blocked.description: Customers, vendors, contacts, employees, users, addresses, communications, attachments, notes, and custom fields are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access financial or broader Sage Intacct data
blocked.description: Accounts, balances, budgets, journals, transactions, bills, invoices, payments, banking, tax, payroll, expenses, purchasing, inventory, projects, reports, administration, and other modules are outside V1.

blocked.label: Call arbitrary Sage Intacct APIs
blocked.description: Other origins, REST objects, fields, filters, query service calls, XML Web Services, DDS, methods, paths, request options, entity switches, and raw requests are outside V1.

blocked.label: Export Sage Intacct data
blocked.description: Automatic pagination, polling, crawling, synchronization, downloads, imports, offline jobs, batch operations, and broad exports are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both private reporting-period reads require matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Both selected read-only tools run without Relay per-action approval while exact token endpoint, API origin, username/company binding, object, paths, limits, audits, redaction, provider permissions, and credential isolation remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts two bounded approval-gated Sage Intacct reporting-period reads and exchanges encrypted customer credentials only on Railway.
Relay mounts two bounded approval-gated Sage Intacct reporting-period reads and exchanges encrypted customer credentials only on Railway.

providerSetup.blocker: No eligible Sage Intacct company, active Web Services subscription, registered production REST application, authorized client ID, dedicated least-privilege Web Services user, client secret, or live acceptance evidence is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, use an eligible Sage Intacct company with Web Services enabled, register a customer-owned production REST application, authorize its Client ID in the exact company, bind a dedicated API-only Web Services user with only reporting-period List/View authority, store the three values through Relay, then validate company or intentional entity binding, token exchange, list and exact reads, approvals, permission denial, credential rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Sage recommends the generally available REST API for new Sage Intacct integrations while continuing the older XML Web Services API.
Sage documents OAuth 2.0 authorization for the Intacct REST API, including the client-credentials grant used by the server-side adapter.
Sage requires REST client applications to be authorized in the target company and lets the company bind a specified Web Services user to client-credential access.
Sage states that the REST API is generally available and requires a Web Services subscription, Web Services user, and applicable permissions.
Sage defines reporting periods as bounded report, budget, and book calendar metadata with identity, name, dates, budgeting state, and status fields.
Sage describes Intacct as cloud financial management software spanning accounting, multi-entity operations, reporting, purchasing, cash, and extended finance capabilities.
Sage publishes the terms governing use of Developer Services and applications built with them.
Sage publishes the privacy policy for Sage Intacct Services; Relay excludes people and private financial records from V1.
